A '''directional rocket''' was an [[Engine/Legends|engine]] fitted to [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]]. Once launched, an escape pod would orient itself in the general direction of the nearest [[Planet/Legends|planet]] or [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] and fire the rockets. When landing on a planet, the rockets were responsible for helping the pod land safely. However, minimal [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] capacity meant that there was only enough power for small directional adjustments and braking once in a planetary [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].<ref name="SWS" />
